status: Specification only; no application tests have been run.

cases.title: An invited representative signs in with their own identity
cases.given: Main client and representative have separate invites
cases.when: Both sign in
cases.then: Each has a distinct audited user; representative cannot submit a main-client contractual decision.

cases.title: Cross-project enumeration is denied
cases.given: User belongs only to Project A
cases.when: Request Project B list rows, detail, search, dashboard counts, file IDs and export
cases.then: No Project B names, records, counts, amounts or files are disclosed.

cases.title: Consultant financial scope is intentional
cases.given: Consultant assigned Project A
cases.when: Open that project's quotation, schedule, invoice and payment history
cases.then: Client-facing financial records are visible; internal notes, receipt evidence, expenses, salaries and profit remain denied.

cases.title: Representative authority cannot be escalated
cases.given: Representative has project access
cases.when: Call quote acceptance, change acceptance or binding material-selection endpoint
cases.then: 403 or equivalent denial; no acceptance/event is recorded; permitted comment remains possible.

cases.title: Admin and owner capabilities remain separate
cases.given: Create admin-without-owner, owner-without-admin and manager accounts
cases.when: Read payroll/profit and individual-performance endpoints and exports
cases.then: Admin can see payroll/profit only; owner can see performance only; manager sees neither, including inferred aggregate values.

cases.title: Account removal is effective across surfaces
cases.given: Signed-in user has a file URL and a queued notification
cases.when: Admin disables them then they request a page/download and job executes
cases.then: All new access and notification dispatch is denied; historic authorship remains.

cases.title: Access changes have an audit record
cases.given: Admin changes assignment, elevated capability and main-client contact
cases.when: Inspect authorised audit history
cases.then: Actor, subject, old/new scope, reason and time are recorded without secrets.

cases.title: Identity cannot be forged
cases.given: Worker endpoint reachable and attacker sends fabricated identity headers
cases.when: Use unsigned/expired/wrong-audience JWT, absent assertion, or guessed email
cases.then: All fail in staging; developer fixture auth is impossible on deployed bindings.

cases.title: Enquiry can finish without a project
cases.given: New lead with requirements and site feasibility
cases.when: Record study then mark enquiry lost/declined
cases.then: History and reason remain; no active project or invoice appears as a side effect.

cases.title: Activation requires the two commercial gates
cases.given: Quoted enquiry with no acceptance or confirmed advance
cases.when: Try activation with each gate missing, client-reported transfer, then both valid
cases.then: Missing gates deny; manager activation succeeds only with current accepted quote and admin-confirmed required advance.

cases.title: Client portfolio and project assignment
cases.given: One main client has two projects and different representatives
cases.when: Each contact opens project switcher
cases.then: Only each contact's assigned projects appear; single main-client authority per project is enforced.

cases.title: Stages and lifecycle are explicit
cases.given: Active project with linked milestone invoice schedule
cases.when: Manager completes a stage, pauses and resumes project
cases.then: Actor/reason/history preserved; stage may trigger due evaluation but does not issue invoice or assert government permission.

cases.title: Staff task and manager deadline authority
cases.given: Assigned team member creates a project task
cases.when: Staff proposes task; manager assigns and revises deadline
cases.then: Task persists; manager-only assignment/deadline changes enforced and prior values retained.

cases.title: Complete and reopen tasks
cases.given: Open task with due date and assignee
cases.when: Assignee completes; manager reopens with reason; clock moves beyond due date
cases.then: History is retained; current overdue classification uses current open state and agreed due date.

cases.title: Internal task evidence stays internal
cases.given: Task contains notes and attachments
cases.when: Client/consultant requests task evidence or related search results
cases.then: Access denied; owner performance can use permitted event metadata without publishing notes.

cases.title: Version-bound consultant review
cases.given: Drawing version V1 sent to two required assigned consultants
cases.when: First approves; second has not approved; unrelated consultant tries approval
cases.then: Approval refers to V1; incomplete set blocks release; unassigned reviewer cannot decide.

cases.title: Manager release is a distinct gate
cases.given: Consultant approved V1
cases.when: Client attempts approval/release, then manager releases
cases.then: Client cannot approve/release; manager release succeeds and records actor/time. Consultant approval alone never publishes.

cases.title: Replacement never hides the current release prematurely
cases.given: V1 released; V2 uploaded and returned for changes
cases.when: Client views drawing; V3 later approved and released
cases.then: V1 stays current during review; V3 release supersedes V1; rejected V2 is not mislabeled superseded.

cases.title: Revision invalidates only the changed version's approvals
cases.given: V1 approved but unreleased
cases.when: Author revises content to V2; attempts release based on V1 approval
cases.then: V2 requires fresh approvals; manager cannot release edited content under V1's approval.

cases.title: Draft file and preview URLs are protected
cases.given: Client knows draft object/thumbnail identifier
cases.when: Request original, thumbnail, preview and notification URL
cases.then: All unreleased internal content denied; released current and permitted historical versions work.

cases.title: Concurrent drawing releases remain consistent
cases.given: Two eligible revisions share expected current-version value
cases.when: Release concurrently or retry same release command
cases.then: At most one current version; stale operation conflicts; retry is idempotent; audit/outbox agree with committed state.

cases.title: Manager publishes selected audience
cases.given: Staff submits photos/progress and keeps separate internal note
cases.when: Client checks feed before and after manager publication
cases.then: Only published approved audience content appears; internal notes never appear.

cases.title: Published update edit needs review
cases.given: Published update V1
cases.when: Staff proposes V2 and another manager returns it
cases.then: V1 remains published until reviewed replacement/retraction; changed text does not silently reach clients.

cases.title: Announcements have a separate audience
cases.given: Manager prepares company announcement for selected clients
cases.when: Publish and open feeds as included and excluded users
cases.then: Only selected audience sees it; project data is not auto-promoted to company-wide content.

cases.title: K-SMART evidence is manual and dated
cases.given: Project with sanction and completion milestones
cases.when: Staff enters observed statuses and uploads screenshots
cases.then: Separate records show entered-by, checked date and evidence; no automatic verification or legal validity claim.

cases.title: Permit evidence can remain restricted
cases.given: Internal supporting screenshot and proposed client status update
cases.when: Manager publishes redacted/permitted update
cases.then: Client receives approved status and shared files only; original sensitive screenshot remains private.

cases.title: Schedule is upfront and versioned
cases.given: Accepted quotation with advance/date/stage instalments
cases.when: Manager revises schedule; staff attempts same action
cases.then: Only manager succeeds; prior schedule/reason retained; clients see correct current schedule and history policy.

cases.title: Due rules resolve date/stage disagreement explicitly
cases.given: Date-only, stage-only, both and either synthetic schedule items
cases.when: Date passes while stage incomplete, then stage completes
cases.then: Each configured policy gives deterministic due state; no accidental default makes every item due.

cases.title: Invoice issue uses approved content
cases.given: Staff drafts invoice and manager approves it
cases.when: Staff edits line/amount after approval then tries issue
cases.then: Edited version requires reapproval; approved unchanged version can issue once.

cases.title: Issued invoice cannot be overwritten
cases.given: Invoice is issued with unique reference
cases.when: Attempt edit/delete; then create permitted correction
cases.then: Mutation denied; linked credit/reversal/replacement preserves original and audit, including concurrent numbering.

cases.title: Only admin confirms real money
cases.given: Client/staff uploads evidence claiming payment
cases.when: They call confirm receipt; admin later verifies and confirms
cases.then: Only admin records confirmed receipt; evidence alone never activates a project or extra work.

cases.title: Part payment and overpayment remain exact
cases.given: Invoice INR 10000.00; confirmed receipts INR 3000.00 and 8000.00
cases.when: Allocate up to outstanding balance
cases.then: Paid allocation 10000.00, outstanding 0.00, unallocated 1000.00; no floating-point drift or negative outstanding.

cases.title: Duplicate receipt confirmation is idempotent
cases.given: Pending receipt with stable idempotency key
cases.when: Confirm twice and replay queue event
cases.then: One economic posting, one receipt and matching audit/outbox; changed payload under same key conflicts.

cases.title: Expense approval and posting
cases.given: Staff submits non-payroll expense or consultant fee
cases.when: Manager reviews then admin posts; staff tries posting
cases.then: Correct actor separation; evidence and project allocation retained; no posting without authorised review.

cases.title: Payroll does not leak through totals
cases.given: Project has salary allocation
cases.when: Non-admin queries total costs, export, chart, search, logs and difference of reports
cases.then: Restricted amounts cannot be obtained directly or by supplied totals; admin sees permitted cost/profit views.

cases.title: Reporting basis and currency are explicit
cases.given: Posted INR events and a separate foreign-currency draft
cases.when: Open invoiced, received and profit reports
cases.then: No cross-currency summing; report names period/basis and costs; invoiced and received are distinct, not additive sales.

cases.title: Balanced postings and period closure
cases.given: Approved invoice/receipt/expense and closed period
cases.when: Post, attempt edit, reverse with explicit authority
cases.then: Debits equal credits per event/currency; journal immutable; closed-period write denied; authorised correction audit retained.

cases.title: Report reproduces source records
cases.given: Known synthetic invoices, credits, receipts and expenses
cases.when: Generate same filtered report twice and reconcile with rows
cases.then: Amounts match source formula and permissions; period, currency and generation time shown; no guessed profit.

cases.title: Only main client accepts additional estimate
cases.given: Change with quoted price and time impact
cases.when: Representative or consultant attempts accept; main client accepts current version
cases.then: Only main-client acceptance binds the current estimate version; others can comment.

cases.title: Extra work gate requires all conditions
cases.given: Accepted change without payment or manager authorisation
cases.when: Attempt start with each condition missing, then fully satisfy
cases.then: Work remains blocked until required admin-confirmed payment and manager authorisation; prepared task is not permission to start.

cases.title: Change revision cannot reuse old acceptance
cases.given: Accepted/paid but unstarted change
cases.when: Revise scope/price and attempt execution
cases.then: Revised work requires fresh acceptance and authorisation plus correct payment assessment; old record remains auditable.

cases.title: References and material decisions
cases.given: Main client and representative upload inspiration
cases.when: Staff creates decision options; main client selects
cases.then: Files scoped correctly; comments distinct from authoritative main-client selection.

cases.title: Material selection respects commercial gates
cases.given: Selected material increases agreed cost
cases.when: Representative changes selection or staff starts extra work
cases.then: Representative cannot overwrite; added cost enters change process; selection alone doesn't authorise work.

cases.title: Snag resolution needs verification
cases.given: Issue with photo/location and assignee
cases.when: Staff provides resolution; manager verifies or reopens
cases.then: States/history distinguish resolved from verified closed; evidence and due date retained.

cases.title: Shared snag hides internal remediation
cases.given: Public-facing issue with internal cost note
cases.when: Client/consultant opens detail and attachments
cases.then: Only approved visible fields and files appear; internal notes/costs remain denied.

cases.title: Due reminders and overdue escalation
cases.given: Clock set to known Asia/Kolkata policy with eligible due items
cases.when: Scheduler runs through normal reminder and escalation times
cases.then: Portal notification and eligible WhatsApp delivery created; unresolved item escalates to admin after configured threshold.

cases.title: Notification eligibility checked at dispatch
cases.given: Queued reminder for now-resolved task or removed user
cases.when: Consumer processes queue later
cases.then: Obsolete message suppressed; read status never resolves task, approves drawing or confirms payment.

cases.title: Retries do not blindly double-send
cases.given: Queue redelivers event or provider times out after possible accept
cases.when: Consumer retries and webhook arrives twice
cases.then: Delivery state reconciles provider ID; ambiguous timeout stays uncertain/reconciled rather than immediate blind resend; duplicates don't create extra portal rows.

cases.title: WhatsApp provider policy and privacy
cases.given: Authorised test number with required opt-in/template configuration
cases.when: Send outside allowed conversation window via approved template path
cases.then: Only minimal safe context and authenticated link sent; unsupported/unapproved setup is blocked visibly, no raw documents or salaries.

cases.title: Webhook verifies sender and state
cases.given: Webhook endpoint receives invalid signature, replay and valid delivery status
cases.when: Process each
cases.then: Invalid messages denied; valid events deduplicated; incoming text never mutates money/approval states.

cases.title: Waiting on you is actionable
cases.given: Seed overdue task, consultant review, manager release, invoice approval and client change decision
cases.when: Each role opens overview and waiting list
cases.then: Only that role's current actionable items appear, ordered by useful urgency and linked to exact version.

cases.title: Performance is evidence-based and owner-only
cases.given: Tasks have original/revised dates, reopened items and quality observations
cases.when: Owner and normal staff open performance views
cases.then: Owner sees disclosed metrics and context; staff is denied; client-driven scope revisions are not auto-scored as employee errors.

cases.title: Client overview is calm and private
cases.given: Project has mixed published/internal updates and multiple payments
cases.when: Client opens phone and desktop overview
cases.then: Published progress, current released drawing, next due payment and relevant decisions shown; no internal task/financial-detail leakage.

cases.title: Archive preserves permitted external access
cases.given: Completed project with current and superseded drawings
cases.when: Archive then sign in as client, consultant, revoked user and outsider
cases.then: Authorised released history remains viewable/downloadable; no drafts/internal data; revoked/outsider denied.

cases.title: Archive is read-only without forgiving balances
cases.given: Project with unpaid invoice is archived
cases.when: Attempt normal edit, append an ADMIN-confirmed settlement for an existing invoice, then manager reopens with reason
cases.then: Operational mutation is denied while archived; normally authorised existing-obligation settlement is appended without reopening, preserving correction approvals. No new invoice, schedule or work is allowed by this exception; controlled reopen rechecks memberships and reminders.

cases.title: Large file upload survives bounded retry online
cases.given: Configured large PDF/CAD/video and allowed chunk size
cases.when: Upload with failed part then retry while online
cases.then: Only failed parts retry; finalised object verified; upload UI reports exact success/failure; no pretend CAD/video preview.

cases.title: Upload cannot select its own audience or object key
cases.given: Client reference uploader
cases.when: Submit foreign project ID, payroll parent, internal path or altered completion metadata
cases.then: Server rejects; storage key assigned server-side; file attached only to authorised parent.

cases.title: Unsafe/unrenderable upload handling is honest
cases.given: HTML/SVG active payload, misleading extension, oversize and unsupported CAD
cases.when: Attempt upload or preview
cases.then: Configured type/size checks enforced; unsafe active content not executed; accepted download-only types labelled; no false malware-scan claim.

cases.title: Download and Range stay private
cases.given: Permitted user views video/PDF then loses access
cases.when: Request Range, HEAD, thumbnail and direct bucket address
cases.then: Current authenticated requests denied after revocation; bucket not public; private responses not shared-cached.

cases.title: Retained file cannot be purged accidentally
cases.given: File referenced by released drawing or issued invoice
cases.when: Cleanup job and ordinary delete action run
cases.then: Referenced object preserved; only eligible temporary upload debris removed according to documented policy.

cases.title: Online-only save failure is visible
cases.given: Phone loses internet while editing
cases.when: Attempt save then reconnect
cases.then: No false saved message; no background offline queue; user can retry explicitly without accidental duplicate write.

cases.title: Responsive accessible core flow
cases.given: Synthetic client and staff sessions
cases.when: Use keyboard and phone-sized viewport for task, drawing and invoice views
cases.then: Visible focus, labelled errors, readable type/contrast and reachable primary actions; no horizontal page overflow.

cases.title: Empty/error/loading/forbidden states are truthful
cases.given: No projects, filter with no match, network failure and revoked access
cases.when: Open relevant screens
cases.then: Distinct recoverable states; no fake KPI data or misleading zero in place of forbidden/unavailable information.

cases.title: Real Worker runtime compatibility
cases.given: Selected pinned scaffold and local Cloudflare bindings
cases.when: Build/preview SSR, mutation, D1 and R2 in workerd
cases.then: All work without Node-only assumptions; adapter and tool versions recorded; no production credentials needed for local check.

cases.title: Environment and secret separation
cases.given: Local/staging/production configuration
cases.when: Run config review and bundle/log inspection
cases.then: Distinct bindings; no secret in client bundle, logs or repository; deploy script names environment explicitly.

cases.title: Restore database and files together
cases.given: Synthetic project with versions, invoices, receipts and archive grants
cases.when: Restore separate backup to isolated recovery environment
cases.then: Counts/checksums/links, invoice balances and authorisation reconcile; result recorded; source production not modified.

cases.title: Migration and recovery gates
cases.given: Seeded database and current deployment
cases.when: Apply next migration and exercise documented failed-release recovery
cases.then: Old retained data preserved; restore/forward-fix plan works; untested destructive migration never reaches production.

cases.title: Integration blockers remain visible
cases.given: WhatsApp/account policy/provider credentials missing
cases.when: Complete local phase and inspect readiness
cases.then: Local fake clearly labelled; blocker recorded; live integration remains disabled; no fabricated success evidence.

cases.title: Authenticated responses never cross-cache
cases.given: Two users with disjoint projects
cases.when: Repeat same routes/actions with different cookies and cache headers
cases.then: No response reuse discloses other user's data; static public brand assets alone use public caching.

cases.title: Charged snag remediation obeys the change gate
cases.given: A snag requires work outside the agreed scope
cases.when: Manager assigns remediation before change acceptance, payment or authorisation is complete
cases.then: Assignment may prepare the task but starting charged work is blocked until P09 commercial gates pass; existing included-scope remediation remains usable.
